test_cases:
[
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_001",
    "title": "Positive Test: Successful LTE Attach and Detach for Multiple UEs under Excellent Radio Conditions",
    "description": "Validate that multiple UEs can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions as per 3GPP TS 23.401.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Single cell scenario with all other cells powered off.",
      "Multiple stationary UEs (at least 2) placed at cell center under excellent LTE RSRP conditions.",
      "End-to-end LTE setup operational without connectivity issues."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure the test setup according to test configuration and record it in the test report.",
      "Activate the serving LTE cell under test.",
      "Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages.",
      "Power ON all multiple UEs and wait for each UE to successfully attach to the LTE cell.",
      "Validate attach success by verifying attach request and attach complete messages for each UE.",
      "Measure attach latency from Attach Request to Attach Complete for each UE and record minimum, average, and maximum latency.",
      "Power OFF all UEs and wait for successful detach procedures.",
      "Validate detach success by verifying detach request and detach accept messages for each UE.",
      "Repeat the attach and detach procedure 10 times and record KPIs including attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach and detach success rate of 100% for all UEs across 10 iterations.",
      "Attach latency values recorded and within expected thresholds.",
      "UEs attached to correct LTE cell as per PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN.",
      "Logs successfully captured and saved for reference."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "All UEs detached from network.",
      "Test logs stored for KPI analysis."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Access the 5G CLI interface using `SSH admin@<IP>` to monitor attach/detach signalling.",
      "Use CLI commands to start and stop logging as per system capabilities."
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Review UE logs to confirm attach to correct LTE cell.",
      "Analyze signalling messages for attach request/complete and detach request/accept.",
      "Assess KPIs recorded in Table 5-4 and Table 5-5."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING"
  },
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_002",
    "title": "Positive Test: Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach with Secondary Node Addition and Release for Multiple UEs",
    "description": "Validate that multiple UEs can successfully perform 5G NSA attach and detach procedures including Secondary Node Addition and Release 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Single cell scenario with all other cells powered off.",
      "Multiple stationary UEs (at least 2) placed at cell center under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions.",
      "End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational without connectivity issues."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure the test setup according to test configuration and record it in the test report.",
      "Activate the serving 5G NSA cell under test.",
      "Start logging to capture call flow and signalling messages.",
      "Power ON all multiple UEs and wait for each UE to successfully attach to the 5G NSA cell.",
      "Validate attach success by verifying attach request and attach complete messages for each UE.",
      "Validate Secondary Node Addition success by verifying SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages.",
      "Measure attach success rate and secondary node addition success rate for each UE and record in KPI Table.",
      "Power OFF all UEs and wait for successful detach procedures including LTE detach and 5G Secondary Node release.",
      "Validate detach success by verifying detach request and detach accept messages and successful Secondary Node release.",
      "Repeat the attach and detach procedure 10 times and record KPIs."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate and Secondary Node Addition success rate of 100% for all UEs across 10 iterations.",
      "Detach success rate of 100% including successful Secondary Node release.",
      "UEs attached to correct LTE/5G cells as per PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN.",
      "Logs successfully captured and saved for KPI analysis."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "All UEs detached and secondary nodes released.",
      "Test logs stored for KPI measurement."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Access the 5G CLI interface using `SSH admin@<IP>` to monitor signalling related to attach, Secondary Node Addition, and detach.",
      "Use CLI commands to capture logs and signalling messages."
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Review UE logs and signalling messages for attach, Secondary Node Addition, and detach.",
      "Verify KPIs as per Table 5-4 and Table 5-5.",
      "Check that Secondary Node Release follows procedure in 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1."
    ],
    "category": "POSITIVE TESTING"
  },
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_NEG_001",
    "title": "Negative Test: Attach Failure Due to Poor Radio Conditions",
    "description": "Verify system behavior when UEs attempt to attach under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss thresholds.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Single cell scenario with serving cell active.",
      "Multiple UEs placed in cell edge or poor radio condition area with LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP below minimum coupling loss."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure test setup with UEs under poor radio conditions.",
      "Power ON all UEs and attempt to attach to the network.",
      "Capture logs and signalling messages during the attach attempts.",
      "Monitor attach success and failure rates."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach procedures fail or have significantly reduced success rate.",
      "Attach failure messages or timeouts observed in logs.",
      "System does not crash and handles attach failures gracefully."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UEs remain detached or retry attach as per protocol.",
      "Logs saved for failure analysis."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Use `SSH admin@<IP>` to monitor attach attempts and failures via CLI.",
      "Enable diagnostic logging to capture failure reasons."
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze attach request and failure messages in signalling logs.",
      "Check UE logs for attach failure indications.",
      "Confirm that KPIs show attach success rate below 100%."
    ],
    "category": "NEGATIVE TESTING"
  },
  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_NEG_002",
    "title": "Negative Test: Detach Failure with Incomplete Detach Request",
    "description": "Verify system behavior when UEs send malformed or incomplete detach requests.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Multiple UEs attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell under excellent radio conditions.",
      "Capability to manipulate detach request messages to be incomplete or malformed."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Power ON UEs and ensure successful attach.",
      "Send malformed or incomplete detach request messages from UEs.",
      "Capture logs and signalling messages during detach attempts.",
      "Observe system response to invalid detach requests."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "System rejects malformed detach requests and does not release UE context erroneously.",
      "Appropriate error or failure messages logged.",
      "UEs remain attached or retry detach as per protocol."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UE context remains valid unless proper detach is performed.",
      "Logs captured for error analysis."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Monitor via `SSH admin@<IP>` CLI for detach request and accept messages.",
      "Enable debugging for error handling in detach procedures."
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Review signalling flow for error messages related to detach.",
      "Confirm UE context and RRC connection remain intact.",
      "Check logs for rejected detach requests."
    ],
    "category": "NEGATIVE TESTING"
  },
